target: 601 Aeger Insolitus

source: 601 Strange Patient
target: 601 Aeger Insolitus

source: Late at night, amidst another round of cheers for a magic trick, Lumian downed the candied wine in his hand and exited the bar with a smirk.
target: Nocte sero, inter aliam turmam plausuum pro artis magica, Lumian vinum saccharatum in manu celeriter deglutivit et tabernam subrisu relicuit.

source: He could already picture Aurore—if she were around—scoffing, “You’re so lame. You’re actually using the Governor of the Sea’s authority and power to pull off a magic trick. Deceiving those drunkards with the real thing. Is this your prank? You’re sure having a blast.”
target: Iam poterat imaginari Aurorem – si praesens esset – irridentem: “Ineptus es. Vere uteris auctoritate et potestate gubernatoris maris ad artificium magicum perficiendum. Illos ebrios re vera fallendo. Estne hic ludibrium tuum? Pro certo valde te delectas.”

source: Lumian responded silently, Being able to utilize superpowers and the Governor of the Sea’s authority for such matters, rather than in battle, should be what you desire, right?
target: Lumian tacite respondit: “Ut superviribus et auctoritate gubernatoris maris ad huiusmodi res uti possis, potius quam in proelio, id quod cupias, nonne?”

source: Isn’t this the joy and future you yearned for?
target: Nonne hoc est gaudium atque futurum, quod desiderabas?

source: In the corridor, illuminated by kerosene wall lamps, Lumian stepped on the creaking floor, making his way back to the first-class suite in the silent, empty surroundings.
target: In vestibulo, a lamparis parietalibus kerosina illustratis, Lumian super pavimentum crepitans ambulavit, iter referens ad conclave primae classis in silentio et solitudine circumstantis.

source: Snores and moans occasionally penetrated the walls on both sides.
target: Stertura et gemitus interdum per parietes utrorumque latere penetrebant.

source: Near the stairs, a room stood open, reflecting the dim yellow light of the fire.
target: Prope scalas, conclave apertum stabat, tenuem flavam igne lucem reflectens.

source: As Lumian passed by, he turned his head and observed the Sacred Emblem of Life, representing Earth Mother, engraved on the wall deep in the room.
target: Dum Lumian praeteribat, caput vertit et Sacrum Signum Vitae, Matrem Terrae repraesentans, in pariete profundo incisum observavit.

source: It portrayed a simple infant amidst wheat ears, flowers, spring water, and other symbols.
target: Depinxit infans simplicem inter spicas tritici, flores, aquam fontis, et alia signa.

source: In front of the Sacred Emblem of Life stood a man in a brown clergyman’s robe.
target: Ante Sacrum Signum Vitae stabat vir in veste cleris fusca.

source: He was less than 30 years old, with clean eyebrows and a light brown beard.
target: Erat infra triginta annos natus, cum supercilia emaculata et barba leviter fusca.

source: Holding a thick book, he preached to the men and women seated in different parts of the room.
target: Tenens librum crassum, hominibus et mulieribus in diversis conclavibus sessis praedicabat.

source: Lumian knew this was a prayer room, akin to a small, mobile cathedral with a dedicated clergyman in charge.
target: Lumian sciebat hanc esse cellam precationis, similem parvae cathedralis mobili cum dedicato clerico praefacto.

source: Common in countries that believed in only one deity, be it on long-distance ships or steam locomotives, they considered the need for believers to quietly pray and listen to teachings.
target: Communia in terris quae unam deitatem colere solebant, sive in navibus longinquo itineris sive in machinis vaporiferis, aestimabant necessitatem fidelium silentiose orare et praecepta audire.

source: Lumian, who could already understand Highlander, memorized the words, “Life’s precious embrace, the harvest’s grace.”
target: Lumian, qui iam linguam Highlander intelligere poterat, verba meminit: “Pretium amplexus vitae, gratia messis.”

source: Retracting his gaze, he entered the corridor, ascending the stairs step by step.
target: Conspicuum revocans, in vestibulum ingreditus, scalas gradatim ascendit.

source: Simultaneously, Lugano, having just finished attending to Ludwig’s supper, heard a knock on the door.
target: Simul, Lugano, qui nuper cenam Ludovici perficiebat, pulsationem ad ianuam audivit.

source: “Who is it?” Lugano was surprised and intrigued.
target: «Quis est?» inquit Lugano, miratus et alacritate captus.

source: This couldn’t be his employer.
target: Hoc certe non poterat esse patronus eius.

source: He possessed the key and would simply open the door.
target: Clavem habebat et ianuam simpliciter aperiret.

source: Moreover, it was nearly 11 p.m. Who would visit at such an hour?
target: Porro fere erat hora undecima noctis. Quis ad talem horam veniret?

source: Could it be that a woman overheard my boasting on the deck, believed me, and came to share a pleasant night?
target: Num ita evenit ut femina in ponte meam iactationem audivisset, me credisset, et ad noctem amoenam communicandam accessisset?

source: As Lugano started to indulge in fantasies, he heard a feeble male voice.
target: Dum Lugano in phantasia se indulgebat, vocem virilem debilem audivit.

source: “I’m here to see Dr. Lugano.”
target: «Ad Dr. Lugano videndum adsum.»

source: Seeking a doctor… Lugano couldn’t help but frown, but he still opened the door.
target: Doctor quaerens… Lugano frons contraxit, sed adhuc ianuam aperuit.

source: Outside stood a man wrapped in a thick tweed coat, a stark contrast to Lugano’s linen shirt and thin pants.
target: Extra stabat vir, veste tweed spissa involutus, prorsus contrarius vestimenti linteae et bracarum tenuum Luganoi.

source: Lugano scrutinized the visitor.
target: Lugano visitatorem diligenter examinavit.

source: “I’m Lugano. What’s the matter?”
target: «Ego sum Lugano. Quid agitur?»

source: The man’s face was pale, his eyes dark, revealing little vitality.
target: Vultus viri pallidus erat, oculi obscuri, parum vitalitatis revelantes.

source: Though young, in his early twenties, he exuded a lifeless aura.
target: Etsi ad initium viginti annos pertinebat, aura mortua emanabat.

source: The man took a deep breath and weakly said, “You can call me Enio.”
target: Vir altius spiritum assumpsit et languide dixit: «Mihi Enio vocare potes.»

source: I heard that you helped several people on the deck discover the true cause of their illness and quickly improved their condition.
target: Audivi te plurimos in ponte adiuvisse, ut causam veram morbi eorum detegerent et statum celeriter melioraret.

source: I want you to treat me.
target: Volo ut me cures.

source: I have the money to pay for the consultation.
target: Pecuniam habeo ad consultationem solvendam.

source: Observing the fellow’s sickly appearance, Lugano sighed and replied, “Come in.
target: Observans habitum aegrotum illius, Lugano suspiravit et respondit: «Intrede.»

source: Keep your voice down.
target: Loquere submissa voce.

source: As you know, I’m the private doctor of a prominent figure.
target: Ut scis, ego sum medicus privatus figurae eminenti.

source: He doesn’t appreciate strangers disturbing him.
target: Non amat ignotos eum disturbare.

source: Once Enio settled on the sofa, Lugano, out of habit, inquired about his condition to conceal his subsequent mystical diagnosis.
target: Postquam Enio in solio consedit, Lugano more consueto de statu eius interrogavit, ut posteriorem diagnosis mysticam celaret.

source: “What’s wrong with your body?”
target: «Quid corpus tuum affligit?»

source: Enio paused for a moment before saying, “Since half a month ago, I’ve become sensitive to the cold and weak. No appetite. Runny nose, repeated coughing, and my condition is worsening.”
target: Enio paulisper cessavit, deinde dicens: «Ab dimidio mense, frigore sensu atque infirmitate laboro. Nullum appetitum habeo; nasus stillans, tussim repetitam, et status meus deterioratur.»

source: “Mm…” Lugano nodded, raising his right hand and tapping his forehead, as if contemplating the significance of the patient’s narrative.
target: «Mm…» annuit Lugano, dextram manum levans et in frontem pulsans, quasi significationem narrationis aegroti meditatus.

source: In reality, he seized the opportunity to activate his Spirit Vision, preparing to discern the other party’s illness from the color, brightness, and thickness of his Ether Body.
target: Revera, occasionem arripuit ut Visionem Spiritus excitaret, praeparans morbum alterius ex colore, claritate, et crassitudine corporis aetherii discerneret.

source: With a swift glance, Lugano nearly jumped out of his skin.
target: Veloci aspectu, Lugano paene ex cute sua exsalivit.

source: Is the patient sitting in front of me still alive?
target: Num aegrotus, qui ante me sedet, adhuc vivit?

source: In Lugano’s eyes, the once white glow shrouding Enio’s Ether Body, signifying overall balance, had turned a somber grayish-black.
target: In oculis Luganoi, fulgor quondam albus corpus aetherii Enii involvens, aequilibrium totum significans, in tristis cinereo-nigro conversus erat.

source: It was a dire indication of his severe illness, teetering on the edge of death.
target: Hoc erat indicium grave morbi severi eius, in limine mortis versans.

source: Yet, it wasn’t this revelation that left Lugano shocked and bewildered.
target: At non haec sola revelatio, sed alia, Lugano stupefactum atque confusum reliquit.

source: What truly sent shivers down his spine was: the orange glow, symbolizing the health of excretion, detoxification, and other vital organs, had dimmed into complete darkness.
target: Quod vere per dorsum eius tremores excitavit, fuit: fulgor aurantius, valetudinem excretionis, detoxicationis, aliisque organis vitalibus repraesentans, in profundam obscuritatem evanuit.

source: No vestige of brightness remained, signaling the complete cessation of their functions!
target: Nullum vestigium fulgoris remansit, indicans omnes eorum functiones omnino cessasse!

source: Likewise, the yellow hue representing the digestive system, the green indicating the heart and regulatory system, and the blue denoting the throat and part of the nervous system had all dulled and lost their radiance.
target: Similiter, color flavus, quem systema digestivum repraesentat, viridis, qui cor et systema regulatorium indicat, et caeruleus, qui gutturam et partem systematis nervosi denotat, omnes opacaverunt et splendorem amiserunt.

source: Enio’s remaining hues were red on his limbs and purple on the surface of his head.
target: Residua colora Enii erant: ruber in membris et purpureus in superficie capitis.

source: W-what does this “diagnosis” imply?
target: Quid hoc “diagnosis” implicat?

source: This meant that Enio was a person with a silent heart, a dormant stomach, and internal organs that had relinquished their functions.
target: Hoc significabat Enium esse hominem corde tacito, stomacho dormiente, atque internis organis functiones reliquisse.

source: Yet, he could still think, move, and speak!
target: Attamen, adhuc poterat cogitare, movere et loqui!

source: Son of a bitch, where did this monstrosity come from!
target: Filius caniculae, unde ista monstruositas orta est!

source: Lugano, facing such an unprecedented “patient,” inwardly cursed, his frame trembling slightly.
target: Lugano, coram hoc inusitato “aegroto” occurrente, intus maledixit, corpusque leviter trepidans.

source: He dreaded the moment when the other might unexpectedly utter, “Doctor, I’m cold. Let me borrow your skin. Doctor, I’m hungry. Let me borrow your stomach and intestines…”
target: Timebat illum momenti, cum alter improvise diceret: «Medice, frigide mihi est. Sume cute tua mihi prestare. Medice, esurio. Sume stomacho et intestinis tuis mihi concedas…»

source: Noticing Lugano’s silence, Enio anxiously inquired, “Doctor, what illness am I suffering from?”
target: Animadvertens silentium Luganoi, Enio anxiose interrogavit: «Medice, quo morbo laboro?»

source: Illness? Lugano muttered to himself urgently, Snap out of it! Your heart has ceased beating; the absence of flowing blood naturally brings about a chilling sensation!
target: Morbus? murmurat urgentissime Lugano ad se: “Emerge ex hoc! Cor tuum iam non pulsat; sanguinis effusis absentia naturaliter frigoris sensum affert!”

source: Those with non-agitating stomachs certainly won’t have much of an appetite!
target: Qui stomachos non excitant, pro certo parum appetitum habebunt!

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lugano pondered for a moment and declared,
target: Dum hae cogitationes per mentem eius transvolabant, Lugano paulisper meditatus, deinde declaravit:

source: “Your condition is grave. I require further analysis and observation to draw conclusions. Can you visit me tomorrow morning?
target: «Status tuus gravis est. Plura analysi et observationi mihi opus est ad conclusionem perducendam. Potesne cras mane me visitare?

source: “Before that, I need to draw some of your blood for research.”
target: «Ante ea, mihi opus est aliquantum sanguinis tui pro studio extrahere.»

source: “No problem.” Despite Enio’s lack of confidence in Lugano, he extended his right hand with the mindset that attempting something was better than nothing.
target: «Nihil est difficile.» Quamquam Enio in Lugano non confidit, dextram manum protulit, existimans aliquid conari melius esse quam nihil.

source: Armed with the necessary tools, Lugano extracted some blood from Enio’s body using a needle, rubber hose, and a glass blood collection bottle.
target: Instrumentis necessariis instructus, Lugano aliquantum sanguinis ex corpore Enii extraxit, utens acu, fistula elastica, et ampulla vitrea ad sanguinis collectionem.

source: Despite their darkened hue, he noted a basic vitality still present.
target: Non obstante colore eorum obscurato, quandam vitalitatem fundamentalem adhuc persentem notavit.

source: Subsequently, he listened to Enio’s heartbeat and detected faint, but existing, beats.
target: Postea, cor Enii auscultavit et pulsus levissimos, sed existentes, deprehendit.

source: Curious… Lugano seized the opportunity of the consultation and prescription to subtly cast a faint light upon his palm, providing Enio with a simple treatment.
target: Curiosus… Lugano occasionem consultationis et praeceptionis adhibuit, ut submissa luce palmam suam illuminaret, Enioque simplicem curationem praestans.

source: Enio’s spirits lifted, and a semblance of strength returned.
target: Animus Enii levatus est, et quasi vis aliqua rediit.

source: “Thank you, Doctor. Your massage and medicine are effective. I appreciate it!” Enio left the suite with a cheerful expression.
target: «Gratias tibi, Medice. Tuum massagium et medicina efficax sunt. Gratias ago!» Enio conclave cum vultu laeto reliquit.

source: None of the previous doctors he had consulted had made the slightest improvement in his condition.
target: Nullus doctorum priore quos consuluerat, minimam emendationem in statu eius adduxit.

source: This time, he intended to set sail to the south, take a steam locomotive to the Church of Earth Mother’s headquarters for treatment.
target: Hoc tempore, intendebat navigare ad meridiem, sumere machinamentum vaporarium, ad sedem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae pro curatione.

source: Baffled, Lugano observed as Enio left.
target: Stupefactus, Lugano eum observavit dum Enio discessit.

source: Soon after, his employer returned.
target: Mox postea, patronus eius rediit.

source: He quickly recounted the encounter to Lumian, concluding with, “I’ve secured his blood. Can you find someone to divine the truth?”
target: Celeriter illam occurrentiam Lumiano narravit, dicens: «Sanguinem eius colligui obtinui. Potesne aliquem invenire qui veritatem divinare valeat?»

source: “Divination?” Lumian chuckled as he received the blood-filled bottle and knocked on Ludwig’s child’s room.
target: «Divinatio?» inquit Lumian subridens, dum ampullam sanguinis plenae accepit et ad conclave pueri Ludovici pulsavit.

source: “Take a sip and see what knowledge you can glean.” Lumian handed the bottle to Ludwig, ensuring no avenue of exploitation slipped by.
target: «Paulum sorbe et vide quid scientiae capere possis.» Lumian ampullam Ludovico tradidit, curans ne qua via usurpationis effugeret.

source: Ludwig’s expression remained stoic, as if sipping bedtime milk.
target: Vultus Ludovici stoicus remansit, sed mirabiliter vacui et inermes, vultusque eius sine modo expressio manebat.

source: He drank down the liquid in the bottle without flinching.
target: Liquorem in ampulla absumpserit sine perterrito.

source: Lugano was bewildered, his eyes reflecting surprise and confusion.
target: Lugano stupefactus erat, oculi eius admirationem et perplexitatem efferentes.

source: After tasting the blood, Ludwig spoke at an adequate pace, “Absent stomach, absent small and large intestine, absent lungs, absent liver and pancreas…
target: Postquam sanguinem gustavit, Ludwig ad modum idoneum locutus est: “Absens stomachus, absentes intestina tenue et crassa, absentes pulmones, absens iejunus et pancreas…

source: “It’s akin to a deceased person relying on mystic forces to persist…”
target: «Simile est viro mortuo qui innititur viribus mysticis ut perseveret…

source: “He won’t last a week…”
target: «Non perdurabit per hebdomadam…»

source: Wh… Lugano was taken aback that Ludwig not only imbibed human blood but also made somber judgments with a straight face.
target: Wh… Lugano stupefactus erat quod Ludwig non solum sanguinem humanum biberit, sed etiam lugubria iudicia facie impertita pronuntiavit.

source: He was also shocked to learn that Enio truly lacked those organs.
target: Etiam perculsus est, cum didicerit Enium vere illa organa deesse.

source: Initially, he believed it was just a loss of corresponding function.
target: Initio credidit id esse tantum defectum functionum correspondentium.

source: According to Ludwig, wasn’t Enio essentially a dead man?
target: Secundum Ludovicum, nonne Enio essentia mortuus vir erat?

source: What had he stumbled upon?
target: Quid invenit?

source: “What should we do?” Lugano turned to Lumian.
target: «Quid faciamus?» Lugano ad Lumian se convertere.

source: Lumian couldn’t help but chuckle softly.
target: Lumian non potuit quin leniter risu subridere inciperet.

source: “What can we do? Locate the captain, the ship’s security supervisor, or the priest in the prayer room, and report this matter. They’ll handle it.”
target: «Quid faciemus? Inveni capitaneum, praefectum securitatis navis, aut sacerdotem in cella precationis, et rem hanc refer; illi se occupabunt.»

source: Lugano nodded and tentatively asked, “But won’t this expose me as a Beyonder?”
target: Lugano annuit et dubius quaesivit: «Nonne hoc me ut Beyonder patefaciet?»

source: “Tell them you’re Louis Berry’s servant,” Lumian advised calmly.
target: «Dic eis te esse servum Louis Berry,» Lumian tranquille monuit.

source: “Alright.” Lugano was fine with being a servant.
target: «Recte.» Lugano contentus erat se servum esse.

source: After a moment’s thought, he asked in puzzlement, “Did you hear any strange sounds at night? I occasionally hear a baby crying.”
target: Post parvum cogitationem, quaestionem perplexus rogavit: «Audivistine aliquas voces insuetas nocte? Interdum audio infans flere.»

source: “Baby?” Lumian asked, shaking his head. “I didn’t hear it.”
target: «Infans?» inquit Lumian, caput agitando. «Non audivi.»

source: Lugano pondered aloud, “Is there a baby crying on this floor?”
target: Lugano palam meditatus est: «Num in hoc pavimento infans flere possit?»

source: Then, he looked at Lumian.
target: Tum Lumian aspexit.

source: “Shall I go find the captain now?”
target: «Nunc capitaneum quaeram?»

source: Lumian’s eyes flickered as he smiled and said, “Tomorrow morning.”
target: Oculi Lumiani micaverunt dum subridens dixit: «Cras mane.»

source: “Alright,” Lugano agreed without hesitation.
target: «Recte,» Lugano sine mora consentivit.

source: He preferred waiting for dawn and sunlight before addressing such a peculiar issue.
target: Mallebat auroram et solem exspectare priusquam talem rem insolitam tractaret.

source: Reporting it at night made him sense an impending, unexpected event.
target: Noctu id referre eum sentire faciebat imminens et inopinatum eventum.

source: The sun provided a reassuring sense of security!
target: Sol sensum securitatis consolatorium praebebat!

source: Lumian didn’t question or provide further advice.
target: Lumian neque quaestionem fecerit neque ulterius consilium dedit.

source: He entered his room, freshened up, and went to bed.
target: In cellam suam intravit, se refecit, et ad lectum se contulit.

source: However, sleep eluded him.
target: Tamen somnus eum elabatur.

source: Instead, he half-closed his eyes, anticipating something.
target: Pro eo, oculos dimidium clausit, aliquid exspectans.

source: After an indeterminate period, Lumian heard a faint creak.
target: Post spatium indeterminatum, Lumian levem crepitus audivit.

source: The door to one of the rooms opened softly.
target: Ianuam unius cellae leniter aperiebatur.

source: Lumian swiftly sat up, silently approaching the door, cracking it open.
target: Lumian celeriter exsurgens, silentio ad ianuam accedens et eam leviter recludens, se contulit.

source: He saw a figure leisurely walk out of Lugano’s servant’s room.
target: Vidit quandam figuram lente ambulantem ex cella servi Luganoi.

source: It was Lugano, clad in a linen shirt.
target: Erat Lugano, indutus camisia linteo.

source: His eyes were open but oddly vacant and unfocused, his face devoid of expression.
target: Oculi illius aperti erant, sed mirabiliter vacui et inermes, vultusque eius sine modo expressio manebat.

source: As if sleepwalking, Lugano made his way to the suite’s door.
target: Velut somnambulans, Lugano iter fecit ad ianuam conclavis.
